name: @ui8kit/layouts
description: Layouts (ADR-0001, the second layer between the prototypes and the apps): the structure of the apps on the UI8Kit primitives and kit-compose compositions, texts and data through props, checked like the prototypes (rules detectors and the four style groups, 8+4 spacing included, zero baseline). Svelte 5 for now. src/stock: the Stock storefront (header, type bar, quick filters, facet column, applied chips, sort, card grid, asset card, preview frame, pagination, theme sheet); src/preview: the live render of a block variant or a screen page from its recipe. Source only: the consumer's Vite compiles it.
